statement: Execution simulation must use side-correct prices and reject fills unsupported by observable quotes.
Optimization reports must expose trade count, holding time, market exposure and benchmark to detect buy-and-hold degeneration.
Parameter selection should prefer stable regions and cross-split consistency over isolated optima.
Any composite candidate score must version metric definitions, normalization, weights and missing-value policy.
Walk Forward is one validation family; its omission requires alternative predeclared stress tests rather than informal confidence.
Long and short implementations must be independently specified and validated when their rules differ.
Universe selection based on historical performance must be separated from liquidity/capacity eligibility and independently validated.
Portfolio gap exposure must be stressed jointly across correlated names, not inferred from per-position risk alone.
